item.text: {"analysis":"The local convolution adapter trial succeeded operationally but reduced authoritative macro validation HR@10 from the supplied 0.580 reference to 0.5725 (−0.0075). Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.605 (−0.015), Industrial_and_Scientific 0.625 (−0.020), Electronics 0.460 (−0.005), CDs_and_Vinyl 0.600 (+0.010). Allocated GPU time was 344.17 seconds. This result does not support adopting the adapter overall; it does not establish why performance declined or whether the proposed local-context limitation exists. Preserve the reference backbone for subsequent isolated experiments.","code_summary":"One independently trained MaskedSASRec checkpoint per category, with tied item embeddings, jointly trained item bias, bidirectional Transformer attention, and output transformation. Added a causal width-3 depthwise convolution, GELU, pointwise projection, and zero-initialized scalar residual gate before the encoder. Adapter inputs and outputs mask padding and use only corrupted sequence representations. Adapter construction preserves the original initialization RNG stream. Retained 256-negative sampled softmax, existing masking/loss weighting, AdamW, seed 42, epoch-wise validation, and lexicographic HR@10/NDCG checkpoint selection. Included adapter diagnostics, versioned metadata, strict checkpoint reconstruction, and exported-predictor parity checks. Prediction loads exactly one selected checkpoint per category; no ensemble or independent scoring component."}
